title: Korean Face Solo #20 (한국 · 30대 · 군림하는 · 메이크업 비닐 블랙립 5단계 · 극한 · 피어싱 P150 · 마이크로더멀 에메랄드 별 · 스티커 야광 별 · 렌즈 코발트 블루(고양이눈) · 점 눈물점+입술점)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the base of her neck and the tops of her collarbones, the frame cutting off there. Her face is large and sharp. Mid 30s.

Subject: A real photograph of a striking adult Korean woman — Korean poised refined beauty luminous light-neutral complexion with a soft peach-beige undertone, mid 30s, hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most dramatic hourglass ratio ever, simultaneously maximum enormous bust AND maximum enormous hips both flaring to absolute impossible extremes while the waist is cinched to impossible minimum, sleek black shoulder-length hair with a side part. Real pores and fine skin grain on her skin, a soft sheen of natural oils, large eyes with bright real catchlights, full lips, a small dark beauty mark just below the outer corner of her left eye like a tear mole, a second tiny beauty mark above the right corner of her upper lip, each one a clearly visible dot of real skin pigment, pushed to the absolute extreme: mirror-black wet-look eyeshadow with a blinding chrome highlight across the lids, a thick graphic black liner, razor-sleek lashes, liquid mirror-gloss black vinyl lips reflecting the light, a razor-sharp cool contour, vivid deep cobalt-blue coloured contact lenses with a vertical slit cat-eye pupil, both eyes the same, fully opaque and solidly saturated across the whole iris with no natural brown showing through, the colour bright and unmistakable, with a darker limbal ring, sitting naturally on the irises and clear of the eyelids, microdermal emerald-green star-shaped gems pressed deep into the skin: a cluster of three small gems at each temple, each gem sitting on a tiny hidden metal base implanted beneath the skin and pressing firmly down so the skin around every gem is visibly pushed in, forming a clear small dimple with a soft raised ring of flesh bulging around its edge, a small natural warm shadow in each dimple, calm healthy skin with no redness or swelling, all gems well clear of the eyes and clear of the piercings, three small glow-in-the-dark star stickers on the cheekbone, softly glowing neon green-blue against the dark, all stickers flat on the skin, clear of the eyes and lids and clear of the piercings, gazing down from beneath lowered lids with the chin raised high as if looking down on a subject kneeling before her, lips sealed in a faint regal curve, an imperious, queenly, commanding expression — a photograph of a real Korean woman's face (East Asian Korean features: a slim V-line face with a small tapered chin and smooth forehead, large double-lidded eyes with soft fullness under them, a straight narrow nose bridge with a small rounded tip, softly full lips, gently straight eyebrows), not an illustration, not a render. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light 

Piercings: An extreme, overwhelming armour of about one hundred and fifty real bronze piercings with a few red-enamel beads among them covering the face and neck: a thick bronze septum ring with a smaller ring above it, three bronze rings through each nostril and a small stud at the tip of the nose; two straight bronze bars across the bridge of the nose between the brows; six thick bronze bars stacked through the outer half of each eyebrow; three rows of five small bronze studs across the forehead above the brows; six small studs up each temple on the bone, well clear of the eyes; two rows of six small studs along each cheekbone; a bronze Medusa stud above the lips with a small stud on each side of it; a big bronze hoop, four smaller rings and a snake-bite ring on each side through the lower lip's edge, and six small hoops along the upper lip's edge; a bronze labret stud and five rings through the chin; six small studs along each jaw; a column of five small studs down each side of the neck; on each ear a full dense row of twelve oversized hoops, thick bars, stretched plugs, helix rings and studs from lobe to top, the biggest hoops hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulders; and ten fine bronze chains looping from the ear hoops to the nostril rings and the septum ring. The piercings are packed so densely that the rows touch and overlap, leaving only hairline gaps of bare skin between them, until the face reads as a single armour of metal; the eyes and eyelids stay clear. Each piece carries small mixed gemstones (diamond, pearl, opal, amethyst, ruby and sapphire) set into alternating pieces. All jewelry is real bronze, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Lighting: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the glints on every piece of metal and every gem read clearly against her skin; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
